skill.name: longbridge-portfolio
skill.description: Access Longbridge brokerage data, analyze portfolio risk and performance, manage orders, and control recurring investments with explicit confirmation for account changes.
skill.summary: Analyze Longbridge portfolios and manage authenticated brokerage actions with confirmation safeguards.
skill.author: longbridge

security_audit.summary: All 58 static alerts are false positives caused by Markdown formatting or ordinary financial guidance; no Ruby backtick execution, system reconnaissance, or prompt injection was found. The skill still has high-impact capabilities because it can access private brokerage data and execute real-money account changes through the Longbridge CLI or discovered MCP tools.

remediation.issue: Order and recurring-investment commands can change a brokerage account and commit real money.
remediation.suggestion: Require host-enforced confirmation with an exact action preview. Disable unattended mutations and reject stale or ambiguous confirmations.

remediation.issue: Account responses can contain balances, holdings, statements, and linked bank-card details.
remediation.suggestion: Request minimum permissions, redact unnecessary identifiers, avoid verbose output, and prevent account data from entering logs or unrelated prompts.

remediation.issue: The MCP fallback discovers tools at runtime without a named server or command allowlist.
remediation.suggestion: Restrict fallback to a verified Longbridge MCP server and explicit read or mutation tools. Apply the same confirmation policy to every mutation.

content.user_title: Analyze and Manage Your Longbridge Portfolio
content.value_statement: Brokerage data and portfolio decisions are difficult to review across separate screens. This skill retrieves Longbridge account data and provides structured analysis and controlled actions.
actual_capabilities: Retrieves account assets, cash flows, stock positions, fund positions, and profit information.
Lists and exports account statements and shows linked bank-card information.
Calculates concentration, allocation, correlation, VaR, CVaR, drawdown, Sharpe, and performance attribution.
Builds rebalancing, risk-return, and tax-loss harvesting analyses from Longbridge data.
Lists, previews, submits, cancels, and replaces brokerage orders after explicit confirmation.
Lists and manages recurring investment plans with detailed previews and confirmation.
limitations: Most account data requires Longbridge authentication and Quote or Trade permissions.
Analysis quality depends on available holdings, prices, cost basis, and historical data.
Risk metrics use historical estimates and do not predict future losses.
The skill provides analysis for reference and does not replace professional financial or tax advice.

use_cases.title: Review Personal Holdings
use_cases.description: Inspect positions, cash, gains, concentration, and currency exposure before making portfolio decisions.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Risk Review
use_cases.description: Measure drawdown, VaR, CVaR, volatility, and scenario losses for a client portfolio.

use_cases.title: Control Brokerage Operations
use_cases.description: Preview and confirm orders or recurring plans while preserving an explicit record of requested parameters.

prompt_templates.title: Show My Portfolio
prompt_templates.prompt: Show my Longbridge portfolio value, cash, positions, and current profit or loss. Highlight missing data.

prompt_templates.title: Diagnose Portfolio Risk
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze my Longbridge holdings for concentration, sectors, currencies, factor exposure, and highly correlated positions. Explain the main risks clearly.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Rebalancing Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare my current portfolio with these target weights: [targets]. Propose trades, costs, taxes, and drift thresholds without executing anything.

prompt_templates.title: Review and Place an Order
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare a preview to [buy or sell] [symbol], [quantity], using [order type and price]. Wait for my explicit confirmation before execution.

output: Largest position: TSLA.US at 24 percent of portfolio value.
Main concern: technology holdings represent 58 percent of invested assets.

output_examples.input: Estimate my portfolio risk over the last year.
output: Historical daily VaR at 95 percent: 2.1 percent.
Results use historical prices and do not predict future losses.

output_examples.input: Create a monthly recurring purchase of 500 USD in AAPL.US.
output_examples.output: Preview: buy 500 USD of AAPL.US monthly. Please provide the day, start date, and end condition before confirmation.

best_practices: Confirm the account, currency, symbol, quantity, price, schedule, and end condition before any mutation.
Use the smallest required Longbridge permission and expose only data needed for the current request.
Treat calculations as estimates and state assumptions, data gaps, dates, and source information.
anti_patterns: Do not execute an order or recurring-plan change from an ambiguous acknowledgement.
Do not invent missing transaction parameters, market data, cost basis, or account values.
Do not share raw account responses, statement identifiers, or bank details beyond the requested task.

faq.question: Which Longbridge permissions are required?
faq.answer: Public margin tools need no login. Portfolio data needs Quote permission, while positions, statements, orders, and recurring plans need Trade permission.

faq.question: Can this skill place real orders?
faq.answer: Yes. It can submit, cancel, or replace orders after showing a preview and receiving explicit confirmation.

faq.question: Can it manage recurring investments?
faq.answer: Yes. It can list, create, update, pause, resume, or stop plans after confirming every required parameter.

faq.question: Does it provide investment advice?
faq.answer: It provides structured analysis for reference. Its outputs do not replace licensed investment, legal, or tax advice.

faq.question: What happens when data is missing?
faq.answer: The skill reports the gap, asks for required details, and avoids calculations or transactions that depend on unknown values.

faq.question: Does it support languages other than English?
faq.answer: Yes. It can respond in English, Simplified Chinese, or Traditional Chinese based on the user's natural-language input.
